## Disclosure Analysis

This 1954 multi-family property shows typical age-related concerns. The dual-unit configuration requires careful review of rental income potential and zoning compliance. Foundation and plumbing are primary areas to investigate given the 70+ year age.

### Red Flags ( 4 )

#### Original Cast Iron Plumbing

Main sewer line is original cast iron from 1954. Video inspection recommended before closing. Replacement cost if needed: $15,000-25,000 for trenchless, $30,000-45,000 for traditional.

Source: Pest Report - Page 6

#### Foundation Crack - South Wall

Horizontal crack noted on south foundation wall measuring approximately 3/16 inch. Seller states crack has been stable for 5+ years. Recommend structural engineer evaluation ($400-600).

Source: TDS - Page 4, Section 8

#### Dual-Unit Permit Status

Property listed as multi-family. Verify both units have proper permits and meet current ADU/rental regulations. Non-conforming units may affect financing or insurance.

Source: SPQ - Page 2

#### Earthquake Zone

Property is 2.3 miles from Hayward Fault. Standard seismic hazard zone. Foundation not retrofitted. Earthquake insurance recommended (~$1,200/year at this value).

Source: NHD - Page 3

### Recommendations
